description: Read a DM conversation's messages, oldest first. Returns the newest `limit` messages; raise `limit` to reach older ones. `has_more` means older messages were cut off. Read-only. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

limit.description: How many of the newest messages to return, 1-200 (default 20).

name: dm_read
title: DM read
